'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Alex W LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex W]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
